question_vi: Có bao nhiêu khách hàng nước ngoài đang hoạt động?
question_en: How many active foreign customers are there?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS active_foreign_customers FROM customer.customers WHERE is_foreign AND status = 'ACTIVE';

question_vi: Giá trần, giá sàn và giá đóng cửa của mã ZTC ngày 2025-06-16?
question_en: What were the ceiling, floor and close prices of ZTC on 2025-06-16?
sql: SELECT p.ceiling_price, p.floor_price, p.close_price FROM product.eod_prices p JOIN product.instruments i USING (instrument_id) WHERE i.symbol = 'ZTC' AND p.trade_date = DATE '2025-06-16';

question_vi: Tháng 6/2025 có bao nhiêu ticket hỗ trợ theo từng loại và điểm CSAT trung bình?
question_en: Number of support tickets per category and average CSAT in June 2025?
sql: SELECT category, count(*) AS tickets, round(avg(csat_score), 2) AS avg_csat FROM crm.support_tickets WHERE opened_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-06-01 00:00+07' AND opened_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00+07' GROUP BY category ORDER BY tickets DESC;

question_vi: Top 10 khách hàng có giá trị danh mục chứng khoán lớn nhất theo giá đóng cửa gần nhất?
question_en: Top 10 customers by portfolio market value at the latest close price?
sql: WITH last_px AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (instrument_id) instrument_id, close_price FROM product.eod_prices WHERE close_price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY instrument_id, trade_date DESC) SELECT c.customer_code, c.full_name, sum(p.total_quantity * lp.close_price) AS market_value FROM custody.positions p JOIN account.accounts a USING (account_id) JOIN customer.customers c USING (customer_id) JOIN last_px lp USING (instrument_id) GROUP BY c.customer_code, c.full_name ORDER BY market_value DESC LIMIT 10;

question_vi: Tỷ lệ cảnh báo AML được kết luận là đúng (true positive) theo từng rule?
question_en: True-positive rate of closed AML alerts per rule?
sql: SELECT r.rule_code, r.name, count(*) AS closed_alerts, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.disposition = 'TRUE_POSITIVE') / count(*), 2) AS true_positive_pct FROM compliance.aml_alerts a JOIN compliance.aml_rules r USING (rule_code) WHERE a.status = 'CLOSED' GROUP BY r.rule_code, r.name ORDER BY true_positive_pct DESC;

question_vi: Tổng cổ tức tiền mặt đã chi trả cho khách hàng trong năm 2025 theo từng mã, sau thuế?
question_en: Total net cash dividends paid to customers in 2025 per symbol?
sql: SELECT i.symbol, sum(en.entitled_cash) AS gross_dividend, sum(en.tax_withheld) AS tax_withheld, sum(en.entitled_cash - en.tax_withheld) AS net_dividend FROM corp_action.entitlements en JOIN corp_action.events ev USING (ca_event_id) JOIN product.instruments i USING (instrument_id) WHERE ev.ca_type = 'CASH_DIVIDEND' AND en.status = 'PAID' AND en.paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00+07' AND en.paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00+07' GROUP BY i.symbol ORDER BY net_dividend DESC;

question_vi: Tổng giá trị giao dịch toàn thị trường theo ngành trong tuần 2025-06-16 đến 2025-06-20?
question_en: Total market trading value per sector for the week 2025-06-16 to 2025-06-20?
sql: SELECT s.name_vi AS sector, sum(p.trading_value) AS total_trading_value FROM product.eod_prices p JOIN product.instruments i USING (instrument_id) JOIN product.issuers iss ON iss.issuer_id = i.issuer_id JOIN ref.sectors s ON s.sector_code = iss.sector_code WHERE p.trade_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-06-16' AND DATE '2025-06-20' GROUP BY s.name_vi ORDER BY total_trading_value DESC;

question_vi: Những khách hàng bị bán giải chấp (force sell) sau margin call trong quý 2/2025, kèm tên RM phụ trách và số lần bị call trong quý?
question_en: Customers force-sold after a margin call in Q2 2025, with their RM and number of calls in the quarter?
sql: SELECT c.customer_code, c.full_name, e.full_name AS rm_name, count(*) AS calls_in_quarter, count(*) FILTER (WHERE mc.status = 'FORCE_SOLD') AS force_sold_calls FROM margin.margin_calls mc JOIN account.accounts a USING (account_id) JOIN customer.customers c USING (customer_id) LEFT JOIN ref.employees e ON e.employee_id = c.rm_employee_id WHERE mc.call_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' GROUP BY c.customer_code, c.full_name, e.full_name HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE mc.status = 'FORCE_SOLD') > 0 ORDER BY force_sold_calls DESC, calls_in_quarter DESC;

question_vi: Dư nợ margin hiện tại theo chi nhánh và tỷ trọng so với tổng dư nợ toàn công ty?
question_en: Current outstanding margin debt per branch and its share of the company total?
sql: SELECT b.branch_code, b.name, sum(l.outstanding_amount) AS outstanding, round(100 * sum(l.outstanding_amount) / sum(sum(l.outstanding_amount)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM margin.loans l JOIN account.accounts a USING (account_id) JOIN customer.customers c USING (customer_id) JOIN ref.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id WHERE l.status IN ('ACTIVE','OVERDUE') GROUP BY b.branch_code, b.name ORDER BY outstanding DESC;

question_vi: Khách hàng nào nạp tiền từ 3 lần trở lên trong cùng một ngày, mỗi lần từ 250 đến dưới 300 triệu, trong năm 2025?
question_en: Which customers made 3+ deposits of 250M to under 300M VND on the same day in 2025?
sql: SELECT c.customer_code, t.value_date, count(*) AS deposits, sum(t.amount) AS total_amount FROM ledger.cash_transactions t JOIN account.accounts a USING (account_id) JOIN customer.customers c USING (customer_id) WHERE t.txn_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND t.amount >= 250000000 AND t.amount < 300000000 AND t.value_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY c.customer_code, t.value_date HAVING count(*) >= 3 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

question_vi: Ngày 2025-06-16 có bao nhiêu lệnh bị từ chối, theo từng lý do?
question_en: How many orders were rejected on 2025-06-16, by reason?
sql: SELECT reject_reason, COUNT(*) AS rejected_orders FROM oms.orders WHERE trade_date = '2025-06-16' AND status = 'REJECTED' GROUP BY reject_reason ORDER BY rejected_orders DESC;

question_vi: Top 10 mã có giá trị khớp lệnh của khách hàng công ty lớn nhất ngày 2025-06-16, tách mua và bán?
question_en: Top 10 symbols by client matched value on 2025-06-16, split into buy and sell?
sql: SELECT symbol, SUM(matched_value) AS total_value, SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'BUY' THEN matched_value ELSE 0 END) AS buy_value, SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'SELL' THEN matched_value ELSE 0 END) AS sell_value FROM oms.executions WHERE trade_date = '2025-06-16' GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 10;

question_vi: Tỷ lệ lệnh đặt qua mobile, web, môi giới và API trong tháng 6/2025?
question_en: Share of orders by channel in June 2025?
sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(100 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM oms.orders WHERE trade_date BETWEEN '2025-06-01' AND '2025-06-30' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY orders DESC;

question_vi: Những tài khoản có trên 20 lệnh bị hủy trong vòng 5 giây sau khi đặt trong một ngày (dấu hiệu spoofing)?
question_en: Accounts with more than 20 orders cancelled within 5 seconds of submission on a single day (spoofing signal)?
sql: SELECT o.account_id, o.trade_date, COUNT(*) AS fast_cancels FROM oms.orders o JOIN oms.order_events s ON s.order_id = o.order_id AND s.event_type = 'SUBMITTED' JOIN oms.order_events c ON c.order_id = o.order_id AND c.event_type = 'CANCELLED' WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, s.event_time, c.event_time) <= 5000000 GROUP BY o.account_id, o.trade_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 20 ORDER BY fast_cancels DESC;

question_vi: Thiết bị nào đăng nhập thành công vào hơn 3 khách hàng khác nhau trong 30 ngày tính đến 2025-06-30?
question_en: Which devices successfully logged into more than 3 different customers in the 30 days up to 2025-06-30?
sql: SELECT device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers, MIN(login_at) AS first_seen, MAX(login_at) AS last_seen FROM oms.client_sessions WHERE login_result = 'SUCCESS' AND login_at >= '2025-05-31' AND login_at < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) > 3 ORDER BY customers DESC;

question_vi: Doanh thu phí môi giới tháng 6/2025 theo chi nhánh?
question_en: Brokerage fee revenue per branch in June 2025?
notes: Needs oms.executions (MySQL) joined with customer.customers/ref.branches (PostgreSQL). Cannot be answered by one database; target this once both sources land in the lakehouse or a federated engine (Trino).
